en: A colorized illustrated view of a landscaped park with winding paths, lawns, trees, and a pond in the foreground. A woman in period clothing walks along a path. In the background stands a castellated building or tower on a hill, and a few smaller buildings among trees. At the top of the image, printed in red capital letters, is the caption identifying the location as Nijmegen's Hunnerpark.
